question: Is the CD limit of detection lower than UV-vis for every strain where both are reported, and by how much?

trace.query: SELECT id, page, text, strength FROM atoms WHERE regexp_matches(lower(text), 'detection|lod|limit') ORDER BY page, id

SELECT id, figure_id, statement, printed_text, value, unit, condition FROM figure_facts WHERE regexp_matches(lower(statement||' '||coalesce(printed_text,'')), 'detection|lod|limit|cd|uv') ORDER BY figure_id, id
SELECT id, page, text FROM lines WHERE page=6 AND line_no BETWEEN 50 AND 70 ORDER BY line_no
SELECT id, figure_id, statement, value, unit, condition FROM figure_facts WHERE regexp_matches(lower(statement), 'lod|detection|limit') ORDER BY figure_id, id

WITH t AS (
SELECT 'P. aeruginosa' AS strain,
 CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L59'), 'OD600 =([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS cd,
 CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L60'), 'versus ([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) AS uv
UNION ALL
SELECT 'L. monocytogenes',
 CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L61'), 'LOD of ([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE),
 CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L61'), 'versus ([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE)
)
SELECT strain, cd, uv, uv - cd AS gap FROM t ORDER BY strain

SELECT
 (CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L60'), 'versus ([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L59'), 'OD600 =([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE)) AS gap_paeruginosa,
 (CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L61'), 'versus ([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE) - CAST(regexp_extract((SELECT text FROM lines WHERE id='p6.L61'), 'LOD of ([0-9.]+)', 1) AS DOUBLE)) AS gap_lmono

rendered:
Yes, where both are reported, CD gives the lower limit of detection. Only the strains P. aeruginosa and L. monocytogenes have both values in the document. The paper states that CD consistently achieved a lower LOD than UV–vis.

P. aeruginosa: CD LOD of OD600[1] 0.0034[2] (CD) versus[3] 0.0066[4] (UV–vis). The CD LOD is lower by 0.0032[5] OD600 units.

L. monocytogenes: CD LOD of OD600 0.0123[6] (CD) versus 0.0125[7] (UV–vis). The CD LOD is lower by 0.0002[8] OD600 units, a much smaller margin than for P. aeruginosa.

No LOD is reported for the other strains by either method, so no comparison can be made for them.
